_comment: Expected-value fixtures for the Pictoria test harness. Paths are relative to the watched folder the harness reads out of meta.db (override with --library). ASSERTION MODEL: `matched` and `min_ratio` are the hard pass/fail contract. Absolute inlier counts are NOT — recolouring destroys most SIFT correspondences (measured: 496 inliers greyscale-identical, ~12 for the same pair once recoloured), so an absolute floor systematically penalises exactly the colourway matches the app exists to find. inlier_ratio is the scale-free signal; the absolute count is only a floor against degenerate fits, so it is reported as a MARGIN WARNING against `warn_below_inliers` rather than a failure.

verify_cases.name: yellow-tile canonical
verify_cases.note: Established 2026-08-15. The query must be trimmed the way search_service.rs::trim_uniform_border trims it before verifying — the raw file scores differently and hides the regression this case exists to catch.

expect_match.baseline: 2026-08-15: 111 inliers @ 0.95. 2026-09-09 after Phase 2c (SIFT nfeatures 4000->1500, candidate decode 1600->1024): 83 @ 0.81.
2026-08-15: 45 inliers @ 0.88. 2026-09-09 after Phase 2c: 11 @ 0.73 — a 4x margin loss that leaves it 1 above pipeline.verify_one's min_inliers=10 hard floor. The ratio held; the count did not.
expect_match.note: same design, recoloured. THE pair to watch — any further SIFT reduction likely drops it out entirely.

expect_match.baseline: 2026-08-15: 11 inliers @ 0.69. 2026-09-09 after Phase 2c: 20 @ 0.67 — went UP, because dropping the candidate decode 1600->1024 moved it closer to the query's own 800px scale.
expect_match.note: pattern found inside a larger slab. Historically the tight one: a min_inliers=12 floor dropped it once, and an 8-DOF homography fit bent it into a false implausible-warp rejection another time.

verify_cases.name: BRASIL GREY false positive stays rejected
verify_cases.note: A genuinely different stone that merely looks similar. If this starts matching, verification has gone too loose.

expect_reject.baseline: rejected as match-outside-frame; 13 inliers found but placed outside the frame (2026-09-09).

colourway_group.name: NATURAL EMPIRE colourways
colourway_group.note: Every pair here is the same design in a different colourway, so every unordered pair must verify. This is the suite that catches a change that quietly starts gating matches on colour. Was 21 pairs (7 files) on 2026-08-15; the library now holds 6 files = 15 pairs, so the count is derived, not hard-coded.

near_family.note: Stage-1 retrieval must surface the canonical matches above the cosine floor, otherwise search never gets far enough to verify them — a silent recall failure the UI cannot show. Floor mirrors config::NEAR_FAMILY_MIN_SIM.

config._comment: Mirrors UI/src-tauri/src/config.rs and core/vector_store.rs. The harness asserts the live sidecar and store agree with these.
